title: Surreal and Abstract Dreamscape | Kelly Boesch - Mistress of Nonsense | 4K
description:
I made these images by using a bunch of my older images as references and they are quite strange but I love the abstract oddness about them. They almost remind me of human coral. There are fish and birds and strange creatures. On these weird ones you just sort of have to let your mind wander a bit LOL I know people don't like when they don't smile but when I tried to make them smile they looked really creepy. So for me, better dour than creepy...as they are already strange. I wrote the song so that it's kind of nonsense but also feels like a story. Using a theme I have used a few times of trying not to fit into a box and allowing yourself to be strange and free. I borrowed some Alice In Wonderland references. It's called Mistress of Nonsense. I love this one. Additional mixing and engineering by Marshall Altman.

Mistress of Nonsense
 
[Verse 1]
One moment and the veil is gone,
A world appears at dusk and dawn.
Goldfinch flying outside the glass,
Some things are too bright to last.
 
[Chorus]
We're all made of nonsense after all,
You were Alice before the fall.
Looking back through memory's glass,
Chasing things too bright to last.
The Queen of Hearts writes every line,
Half of yours and half of mine.
You are Alice, lost in the dance,
Every dream is worth the chance.
 
[Verse 2]
You lived inside a borrowed life,
The dream you hid like a secret knife.
The self you kept behind the door,
The girl you were afraid to be more.
 
[Chorus]
We're all made of nonsense after all,
You were Alice before the fall.
Looking back through memory's glass,
Chasing things too bright to last.
The Queen of Hearts writes every line,
Half of yours and half of mine.
You are Alice, lost in the dance,
Every dream is worth the chance.
 
[Bridge]
Your soul stayed when you walked away,
Holding everything you couldn't say.
The life you left, the life you chose,
Only you know how the story goes.
 
[Outro]
And so you became,
The mistress of nonsense, wild and untamed.
